stories.title: Nehemiah's Prayer and Commission
stories.summary: Nehemiah, cupbearer to Artaxerxes, hears that Jerusalem's walls are broken. He prays, then asks the king for leave and letters of passage to rebuild.

stories.title: Rebuilding the Wall
stories.summary: Nehemiah inspects the ruined wall by night and organizes the people to rebuild. Sanballat and Tobiah mock and plot, so half the workers stand guard while the rest build.

stories.title: Debt Relief
stories.summary: Poor families are losing land and children to debt. Nehemiah rebukes the nobles, they return what they took, and he refuses the governor's food allowance.

stories.title: The Wall Completed
stories.summary: Plots against Nehemiah fail, and the wall is finished in fifty-two days. A register of those who returned is recovered.

stories.title: Ezra Reads the Law
stories.summary: Ezra reads the law to the assembly, the Levites explain it, and the people keep the Feast of Booths. They confess their sins and recount Israel's history in prayer.

stories.title: The Covenant and Dedication of the Wall
stories.summary: The leaders seal a covenant to keep the law, tithe and not intermarry. Lots settle people in Jerusalem, and the wall is dedicated with two processions.

stories.title: Nehemiah's Reforms
stories.summary: On a return from Persia, Nehemiah removes Tobiah from a temple room, restores tithes, shuts the gates on the Sabbath, and confronts those who married foreign women.
